Intro: Hello Dear, I was wondering if I could get that vase back. I've been so busy lately, it's been hard to keep track of everything.
The twins, especially, have been worrying me lately. They seem to be in a world of their own right now, it's been difficult to talk lately.
I know those two have been visiting this store, so could you keep an eye on them for me?
This city is getting more dangerous every day, I'm afraid something will happen to them.
Success: Thank you…where is the vase? Dear, do you not have it? I thought I could trust you with this.
Fail: …where is the vase? Dear, do you not have it? I thought I could trust you with this.
Reject: Point taken. No need to worry about the vase then. I'll be heading out.
